summary: MLS is on a World Cup break (May 25–July 16), with Lionel Messi suffering a leg injury in Inter Miami's final pre-break 6-4 win over the Philadelphia Union, who also fired head coach Bradley Carnell in a front-office shake-up. In the Premier League, the summer transfer window opens June 15 and is already buzzing with Brighton making a £30m offer for Tottenham defender Jan Paul van Hecke, while Jadon Sancho prepares to leave Manchester United as a free agent ahead of a 2026/27 season that starts August 22 with Arsenal as defending champions.
headlines: Messi suffers leg injury in Inter Miami's 6-4 victory over Philadelphia Union before MLS World Cup break
Philadelphia Union fire head coach Bradley Carnell in sweeping front-office overhaul
2026 MLS All-Star Game confirmed for July 29 at Bank of America Stadium in Charlotte, NC
Brighton submit £30m bid for Tottenham defender Jan Paul van Hecke as EPL transfer window nears
Jadon Sancho to exit Manchester United as free agent; Premier League 2026/27 season set to kick off August 22
